title: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning Platform
description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.
 We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our ML Training & Serving team. You will directly lead a team of platform engineers and combine effective people leadership with strong technical judgment in ML infrastructure. Working closely with senior ICs and partners across Machine Learning and Infrastructure, you will help shape the team’s roadmap, drive execution, and ensure the platform reliably supports Affirm’s ML priorities.
 What You'll Do
 Partner with senior ICs and engineering leadership to define and execute the roadmap for ML training & serving, spanning model training, deployment workflows, GPU infrastructure, and low-latency model serving.
 Lead, coach, and grow a team of platform engineers while staying closely engaged in technical decisions and execution.
 Drive delivery and operational health for the team’s infrastructure, balancing reliability, developer experience, performance, and cost.
 Evaluate and adopt modern ML infrastructure capabilities as Affirm’s needs evolve, including transformer-based workloads and GPU compute.
 Collaborate with ML modeling, product, and infrastructure teams to ensure the platform supports Affirm’s highest-priority ML initiatives.
 Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing platform engineers.
 What We Look For
 7+ years of industry experience in software and/or machine learning engineering, including 2+ years managing engineers and meaningful hands-on software engineering experience.
 Strong experience building and operating production ML or distributed systems infrastructure, with hands-on experience in at least one of model training, model serving, deployment workflows, or GPU infrastructure.
 Solid understanding of ML data needs, including training datasets, data quality, reproducibility, and evaluation data.

title: Enablement Manager (Support)
description:
Role Summary
 The Support Enablement Manager builds and scales the training, onboarding, and quality-assurance programs that power a high-performing contributor-support team. The role owns the full enablement lifecycle — from designing and delivering onboarding curricula to formalizing QA frameworks that drive measurable improvement across the support organization. Enablement priorities are set in partnership with the Regional Manager; the Manager owns execution end to end within that scope and brings recommendations when scope needs to change. This is a hands-on leadership role: assess the landscape, prioritize, build the plan, lead a small team, and deliver results, working cross-functionally with Regional Managers, Team Managers, SMEs, and WFM.
 Key Responsibilities
 Own the enablement function end to end — assess gaps, prioritize initiatives, and drive them to completion within scope agreed with the Regional Manager; surface recommendations when scope should change.
 Onboarding & curriculum — own the end-to-end onboarding for new Support Specialists; design, build, and continuously improve structured training that reflects current workflows, tools, and contributor-experience standards, so agents ramp quickly and confidently.
 Coaching & development — build and maintain ongoing training across all tiers; partner with Team Managers to close skill gaps with targeted interventions that translate into performance improvement.
 Quality assurance — own the QA program: scorecard design, calibration, audits, and reporting; keep QA consistent, fair, and actionable, and require that quality feedback cite a current source document.
 Knowledge base / SSOT — own the support knowledge base and its review cadence so guides stay accurate and current, and retire stale content.
 Team leadership — lead, develop, and manage a small team of Enablement & QA Specialists; set priorities, coach, and keep the team unblocked and accountable to high-quality output.

title: Teamleitung Accounting/Head of Accounting (all)
description:
Als spezialisierte Personalberatungsboutique bringen wir die besten Talente im Finanzbereich mit führenden Unternehmen in Berlin zusammen. Im Auftrag unseres Mandanten, einem Unternehmen aus dem Bereich eCommerce, suchen wir aktuell nach der passenden Persönlichkeit für die Position Teamleitung Accounting/Head of Accounting (all).
 Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt!
 Aufgaben
 Leitung und Förderung des Buchhaltungsteams aus 3 Mitarbeitenden, um dabei eine positive und leistungsorientierte Teamkultur zu fördern, in der sich die Mitarbeitenden optimal einbringen und weiterentwickeln können
 Sie verantworten die Sicherstellung und Überwachung der Finanzbuchhaltung sowie die fristgerechte und ordnungsgemäße Erstellung der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB. Darüber hinaus gewährleisten Sie ein aussagekräftiges Reporting an das Management und den CFO.
 Sie treiben die Digitalisierung und Automatisierung der Finanz- und Buchhaltungsprozesse kontinuierlich voran und schaffen damit die Grundlage für mehr Effizienz, Transparenz und Skalierbarkeit.
 Sie verantworten das Cashflow-Management einschließlich der Liquiditätsplanung und -prognose und stellen ein nachhaltiges Working Capital Management sicher
 In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Controlling sorgen Sie für eine belastbare Finanzplanung, unterstützen Budget- und Forecast-Prozesse und analysieren finanzielle Abweichungen zur Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen.
 Sie koordinieren externe Jahresabschluss- und Steuerprüfungen und gewährleisten die Einhaltung aller handels-, steuer- und regulatorischen Anforderungen.
 Sie tragen die Verantwortung für die ordnungsgemäße Erstellung und fristgerechte Abgabe der steuerlichen Erklärungen, insbesondere im Bereich der Umsatz- und Ertragsteuern
 Als zentrale Schnittstelle arbeiten Sie eng mit den Bereichen Controlling, Operations, Sales und weiteren Fachabteilungen zusammen und fördern eine partnerschaftliche sowie lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit im Unternehm…

title: Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead, Global B2B
company: Brinkdoor Ltd., London, Zweigniederlassung Erlenbach, Schweiz
description:
Munich or London | Hybrid | Global remit
 Are you an experienced B2B marketer ready to move beyond simply delivering campaigns and take genuine ownership of a marketing function?
 I am partnering with an established, highly respected international business at an exciting point in its development. Following a recent management buyout and with ambitious global growth plans underway, they are looking for a Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead to help shape the next stage of their journey.
 This is a newly created, highly visible role, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the senior leadership team and Board.
 It is an unusual opportunity for someone who wants both strategic influence and hands-on ownership .
 Tasks
 You will take the lead in translating ambitious business growth plans into a clear and commercially focused marketing strategy.
 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a large corporate marketing machine.
 Instead, you'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of marketing, strengthen and evolve an established brand, support international expansion and new service launches, and gradually build the marketing capability around you.
 You'll work closely with an existing Marketing Executive who supports the tactical execution, while you provide the strategic direction, commercial thinking and senior stakeholder partnership.
 Your remit will include:
 Developing and delivering the overall marketing strategy in line with business objectives
 Acting as a trusted marketing adviser to the CEO, Board and senior leadership team
 Strengthening the company's positioning, messaging and external profile
 Supporting the launch of new services and expansion into new international markets
 Developing digital, social, content, PR and communications strategy
 Partnering with business leaders to turn marketing activity into tangible business-development opportunities
 Acting as guardian and ambassador of the brand globally
